twin_model.primitives.buffer

Buffer primitive for material storage between equipment.

This module provides a buffer primitive that represents material storage locations (queues, conveyors, accumulation tables) between processing equipment. It emits observables about material flow, levels, and dwell times.

Classes

BufferItem

Item stored in buffer with metadata for tracking.

BufferPrimitive

Generic buffer for material storage.

class twin_model.primitives.buffer.BufferPrimitive(env, config)[source]

Bases: twin_model.primitives.base.BasePrimitive

Generic buffer for material storage.

Emits observables for: - Level changes (material in/out) - Dwell time distribution - Overflow/underflow events - Capacity utilization patterns - Product mix in buffer
